text:
Type: jute flatwoven runner with colored stripes
Use: adding texture by a bed or in a passage; hallway, bedroom, kitchen, entryway
Style: bohemian, Scandinavian, rustic
Materials: woven jute, off-white cotton-look center, knotted colored yarn cords
Colors: natural tan, off-white, red, pink, navy, yellow, green
Shape: small long rectangle, natural ends, horizontal cord stripes with knotted tips poking out at the sides, flat, light visual weight
Feel: crafted, cheerful, earthy, playful
Goes with: light wood, white walls, colorful textiles, plants; bohemian, Scandinavian or eclectic rooms

product.name: TILST
product.description: Handwoven by skilled craftspeople, and therefore unique.
